status_semantics.ACTIVE-VERIFIED: Recent, retrievable evidence confirms the integration works in the named environment.
status_semantics.CONFIGURED-UNVERIFIED: Repository configuration or provider resources exist, but end-to-end health is not proven.
status_semantics.RETIRED: Intentionally removed from the active architecture.

integrations.purpose: Source validation, runner execution, release evidence
integrations.current_limitation: The observed job fails before step initialization; runner identity, logs, and artifacts are unavailable.
integrations.next_verification: Obtain a real job assignment, instantiated steps, successful tests, retrievable logs, and correlated artifact.

integrations.purpose: Canonical web edge runtime and asset delivery
integrations.current_limitation: Repository runtime source and reported live runtime version require reconciliation; public reachability remains unverified.
integrations.next_verification: Correlate deployed version with source commit and verify canonical-domain health and critical routes from an independent public network.

integrations.current_limitation: Configuration files alone do not prove deployed bindings, rules, authentication, or end-to-end data access.
integrations.next_verification: Verify project identity, bindings, security rules, and a non-destructive staging health check without exposing credentials.

integrations.current_limitation: Live versus test mode and payment end-to-end behavior are not established by repository source alone.
integrations.next_verification: Verify provider mode and secret bindings, then run a safe test-mode transaction and webhook replay/idempotency checks.

integrations.current_limitation: Observability is enabled in checked-in configuration, but telemetry arrival, retention, alert routing, and incident ownership are unverified.
integrations.next_verification: Generate a controlled request, verify telemetry is searchable, and test an alert with a named responder.

integrations.purpose: Isolated synthetic bottleneck and scaling experiments
integrations.current_limitation: Scaffold exists on the recovery branch; no cluster has been created and no test has run.
integrations.next_verification: Build the image, create a disposable local Kind cluster, validate NetworkPolicy enforcement, execute bounded tests, capture metrics, and delete the cluster.
